The '''Shadow Security Droid''' was a type of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] that was developed and used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Features==
Shadow Security Droids were small, hovering black-colored droids. Inside, they contained a unique and highly-specialized type of droid brain that had had the consciousness of a living being transplanted into it through use of a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] technique. The droids were very dangerous and were armed with [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blasters]]. They had red-[[Color/Legends|colored]] targeting diodes.

==History==
The Shadow Security Droids were one of the Empire's first experiments and were a precursor design to the much larger [[Shadow Droid]]s.

A number of Shadow Security Droids were deployed aboard a [[Golan space defense platform]] in the [[Beshqek system]]. Four of them attacked a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents that boarded the platform during the [[Battle of Byss]].
